positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligenceAsset
positions.frame: what is the value distinction between the intelligence/perspective one keeps and the substrate/intelligence one merely rents or passes through?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same matched-antithesis maxim (owned/rented; commodity/asset) that the register pass flags as a shared aphoristic-technical signature and the value pass reads as the same autonomy/self-enhancement appeal — ownership of perspective framed as the thing worth keeping against a commoditized substrate. Conviction readings differ in degree (src-2 a flat claim, src-3 a creed-like principle) rather than in direction, so the set holds that gradient in tension under one frame rather than resolving it.

positions.name: PipelinePositioningMetaNote
positions.frame: what function does this text serve within the navigation/provenance regression pipeline that will read it?
positions.why: Both expressions step outside the thesis content to describe the document's own instrumental role — src-1 names itself a positioning note for the navigation/provenance regression guard, src-4 explains it restates the thesis so a navigating extractor has prior positioning to connect to. Both share the same footing (Xena as animator and author, no distinct principal) and both land at the weakest, most meta-instrumental conviction level (notion) rather than asserting anything about owned/rented intelligence itself — a self-referential frame distinct from the thesis the note restates.
